economy.summary: Her campaign platform says an increase in the Pennsylvania minimum wage to at least $18 an hour is long overdue, and supports measures to lower everyday expenses for families, including prescription drug and child care costs.
economy.short: Supports $18 minimum wage; lowering prescription drug, childcare costs.

taxes.summary: In a candidate interview about health insurance affordability, she pointed to the Working Pennsylvanians Tax Credit, which reduces taxes for low- and moderate-income workers, as an example of incremental progress, saying there is room for policies like that to add smaller subsidies.
taxes.short: Says tax credits for lower-income workers can add subsidies.

abortion.summary: Her campaign platform says she will staunchly defend the right to choose for Pennsylvania women and supports healthcare and childcare policies that enable family planning choices.
abortion.short: Says she will defend the right to choose.

education.summary: Her campaign platform says she will work to ensure Pennsylvania meets its constitutional requirement to fully fund public schools, and that she will stand against efforts to privatize public schools, opposing voucher programs.
education.short: Supports full public school funding; opposes vouchers, privatization.

healthcare.summary: As a state representative, she co-introduced legislation establishing a tax credit for small businesses that contribute toward employee health insurance premiums purchased through Pennie, saying the state needs to act to close coverage gaps after enhanced federal premium tax credits expired.
healthcare.short: Co-sponsored small-business tax credit for employee health premiums.

energy.summary: In a candidate interview she said that while fracking is a reality in Pennsylvania, regulations must protect health and the environment in affected areas and the state should move away from fossil fuels toward clean energy production. She also said reducing pollution from cars is one big way to address climate change.
energy.short: Supports fracking regulations; moving from fossil fuels to clean energy.
